relationships.evidence_quote: Caspase-1 activity was significantly higher in MIO-M1 cells treated with NM at ≥124μM (Fig. 8A).

relationships.subject: nitrogen mustard
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 showed higher expression at gene (Fig. 8B) and protein (Fig. 8C, D) in ≥250μM NM concentrations.

relationships.subject: nitrogen mustard
relationships.evidence_quote: GSDMD expression showed a ~10-fold increase in all the concentrations (50–250μM) of NM treatment (Fig. 8E, F), indicating pyroptosis in MIO-M1 cells.

relationships.subject: nitrogen mustard
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α expression was significantly increased in MIO-M1 treated with ≥125μM of NM treatment (Fig. 6B).

relationships.subject: nitrogen mustard
relationships.evidence_quote: Cox-2, an inflammatory mediator showed a significant dose-dependent increased expression in all the NM concentrations used (Fig. 6C).

relationships.subject: nitrogen mustard
relationships.evidence_quote: VEGF showed increased expression in low doses of NM starting from 50μM to 250μM (Fig. 6G).

key_findings: Nitrogen mustard induced Müller cell gliosis with oxidative stress and cell death
NM activated caspase-1, NLRP3 inflammasome, IL-1β/IL-18 and GSDMD, indicating pyroptosis
